missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Память' is a soft-sign feminine noun in the nominative as the thing possessed. 'Отличная' is the agreeing feminine adjective and 'у него' shows whose memory it is.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Память' is the accusative direct object of 'развивает'; soft-sign feminines keep the same form in the accusative singular. 'Хорошую' agrees and 'спорт' is the subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive under negation. 'Памяти' is the genitive after 'нет'; soft-sign feminines take '-и'. 'Совсем' intensifies the absence and 'у старика' shows whose.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Памяти' is the dative form, the thing benefited, governed by 'полезно'. Soft-sign feminines take '-и' in the dative, and 'упражнение' is the subject.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after verb. 'Памятью' is instrumental because 'обладать' governs the instrumental case; soft-sign feminines take '-ью'. 'Прекрасной' agrees and 'он' is the subject.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'В памяти' uses the prepositional form 'памяти' after 'в' to mean staying in memory. 'Событие' is the neuter nominative subject of 'осталось'.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Память' is the feminine nominative subject of 'хранит'. 'Воспоминания' is the accusative plural object and 'наши' agrees with it.

missions.phrase: Я знаю это стихотворение по памяти.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative in fixed phrase. 'По памяти' uses the dative form 'памяти' after 'по' to mean from memory. 'Стихотворение' is the accusative object and 'я' is the subject.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Память' is the accusative object of 'почтили' in the fixed sense of honouring memory. 'Героев' is the genitive plural showing whose memory.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Память' is the feminine nominative subject of 'слабеет'. 'С годами' is an instrumental time phrase meaning over the years.
